name: Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisboa
positioning: Classic city hotel on Avenida da Liberdade in central Lisbon, with a garden pool, the Anantara Spa and a seafood restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Baixa, Chiado and Principe Real
Families wanting suites, connecting rooms and babysitting
Guests travelling with a small dog or cat

facts.text: The hotel is on Avenida da Liberdade, in the heart of Lisbon.
The hotel is just steps away from Baixa, Chiado and Principe Real.
Eduardo VII Park and the Botanical Garden are within walking distance.
Avenida metro station, on the Blue Line, is a 2-minute walk away.
Lisbon Airport is approximately a 20-minute drive, and private transfers can be arranged on request for an additional fee.
The Lobby Bar serves light bites with live music.
The Pool Bar offers light meals and drinks in a garden setting.
Rooms have custom linens, oversize bathrooms with soaking tubs, and desks.
Rooms include a Nespresso machine and a pillow menu.
Families are welcomed with suites, connecting rooms and babysitting services.
Small pets, meaning dogs and cats up to 25 kg, are welcome for a nightly fee per pet.
The hotel has 12 meeting rooms, including a Conference Centre.

highlights.text: The lobby is decorated in gold and turquoise.
SEEN Lisboa by Olivier offers panoramic views, eclectic cuisine and cocktails.
Cervejaria Liberdade serves Portuguese seafood and traditional dishes, sourcing its seafood from across the Portuguese coastline.
Guests can relax at the Anantara Spa.
The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool surrounded by lush gardens.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the sprawling property takes a day or two to find your way around.
Private indoor parking with valet service is available, but daily charges apply.
WhataHotel notes the urban location comes with busy street noise.
